applies_to: New multi-phase repository migrations, overhauls, maintenance programs or other ordered workflows started after 2026-09-05.
rules: A PASS checkpoint for phase N must exist before phase N+1 may be recorded as complete.
Checkpoint files are immutable after creation; corrections require a separate explicit erratum/checkpoint record rather than overwriting history.
A PASS completion_commit must exist in Git history and contain every path listed in produced_artifacts.
The predecessor_checkpoint field must point to the immediately preceding phase checkpoint.
Mutable execution-state files may summarize progress but are not a substitute for immutable per-phase completion checkpoints.

legacy_overhaul_exception.reason: The original process predates this policy. Phase 3-10 individual completion checkpoints were not preserved, so the exact historical phase-completion order cannot be retroactively made provable.
